result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the rightmost restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated and not fully visible.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol' restaurant card on the far right is cut off mid-name, and the card content is partially hidden beyond the screen viewport. This prevents users from seeing the complete restaurant name and potentially other information.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all cards in the horizontal scroll section are fully visible or provide clear scroll indicators (arrows or visual cues) to show users there is more content to scroll through. Adjust card width/spacing or implement proper carousel behavior.
